$comment: Hand-written (B-13); proposed config/clients/<id>.json (ARC-16, ONB-01). The loader and its pydantic model come with B-18; the files themselves are the owner step W2-E1 (config/** is protected). The PSA company record is the source of truth for the id (D6-15). Regimes are set by the MSP's compliance owner, never by code (D6-12). model_processing has no default: a missing value is an error, never a silent hosted route (D6-11, STD-CF-3).
title: Client
description: One managed client: who it is, which rules apply, which levers and jobs are on, and how adapters reach it.

id.description: Must match the file name (checked by the loader).

psa_company_id.description: The PSA company id (for example an Autotask company id), written as a string (D6-15).

regimes.description: Set by the compliance owner (D6-12). An empty list means none recorded yet, not that none applies.

model_processing.description: Which models may see this client's text (D6-11). Every client starts at none.

vault.description: Key Vault layout (D6-10); dedicated only where a contract requires it.

enabled_levers.description: A subset of the lever registry; the loader checks that each name exists.

bindings.description: One binding per external system; an adapter instance is built from exactly one (TEN-04, B18-1).

Implementation.description: mock, or a real adapter name (for example autotask, datto-rmm, itglue, graph).

CredentialRef.description: A Key Vault secret NAME (D6-10: client-<id>-<purpose>), never a value (STD-CF-7).

access.description: D6-09: GDAP by default; app registration only by documented exception.
